Index: src/context.test.ts
===================================================================
--- src/context.test.ts
+++ src/context.test.ts
@@ -114,8 +114,29 @@
       'https://example.com/%E3%81%93%E3%82%93%E3%81%AB%E3%81%A1%E3%81%AF'
     )
   })
 
+  it('c.redirect() encodes CR and LF', () => {
+    let res = c.redirect('https://example.com/\r\nSet-Cookie: injected=true')
+    expect(res.headers.get('Location')).toBe(
+      'https://example.com/%0D%0ASet-Cookie: injected=true'
+    )
+
+    res = c.redirect('https://example.com/\r')
+    expect(res.headers.get('Location')).toBe('https://example.com/%0D')
+
+    res = c.redirect('https://example.com/\n')
+    expect(res.headers.get('Location')).toBe('https://example.com/%0A')
+  })
+
+  it('c.redirect() preserves percent-encoded CR and LF', () => {
+    const uppercase = 'https://example.com/%0D%0ASet-Cookie: injected=true'
+    expect(c.redirect(uppercase).headers.get('Location')).toBe(uppercase)
+
+    const lowercase = 'https://example.com/%0d%0aSet-Cookie: injected=true'
+    expect(c.redirect(lowercase).headers.get('Location')).toBe(lowercase)
+  })
+
   const unchangedURLString = [
     'https://example.com/%hello', // invalid ASCII chars
     'https://example.com/%E3%81%93%E3%82%93%E3%81%AB%E3%81%A1%E3%81%AF?abc',
     'https://localhost/api?redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com', // with ://

part.text:
Fixed the header injection risk in `c.redirect`.

- `src/context.ts`: CR and LF are now percent-encoded as `%0D` and `%0A` in the `Location` header. Existing multibyte encoding and already percent-encoded URLs remain unchanged.
- `src/context.test.ts`: added regression tests covering raw CR/LF, standalone CR/LF, and uppercase/lowercase percent-encoded CR/LF inputs.

Verification: `pnpm exec vp test --run src/context.test.ts` — **65 tests passed**.
